title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — act is of the person, vice of nature; so vitium fits head Adam even more
pass_a_gloss: Common tag: the act is of the person, the vice of nature—so the vitium fits Adam as head/origin sustaining our person even more than the singular paradise act.
pass_b_english: That is commonly said to belong to the person; this, to the nature. So it suited Adam as our head and origin, and as sustaining our person, equally or even more than that actual sin, which was a singular act.
source_text: Illud vulgo dicitur esse personae, hoc naturae. Itaque aut aeque aut magis etiam conveniebat Adamo ut capiti nostro & origini, & nostram personam sustinenti, quam peccatum illud actuale, quod actio fuit singularis.

choices.choice: Vitium of nature fits head even more
